QUOTE CHECK NEEDED: the fetch tool limits verbatim excerpts to 125 characters, so it returned the KTVH quote in two pieces ('As a senator, I'd have the obligation to be sure that we get the benefits of innovation,' and 'without having any harm from a new technology,' said Alme) and stated they form one continuous quoted paragraph; I joined them on that basis. A reviewer should check the exact sentence on the page. Date: the KTVH page shows no posting date; the fetch tool says Alme spoke Monday 31 August 2026, consistent with the existing KULR-8 entry. Other KTVH quotes left out as data-center-only (D, not more substantial): 'Those are some of the important guardrails that have to happen, as well as hiring local jobs'; 'There's going to be positive tax base opportunities here for communities, as well as good-paying jobs.' NBC Montana direct quotes ('They need to make sure they pay their own way and they need to hire local jobs'; 'We should leave this to our local communities to decide.') are data-center-only and left out. No source shows Alme signing the 23 September 2026 China letter (he is not on the signer list and was not a senator) or co-sponsoring the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act.
